description: Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation - The Motor Traffic (Signs, Signals, Symbols and Road Markings) Regulations No. 01 of 2014 made under Sec. 237 of the Motor Traffic Act (Chapter 203)
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport under the Motor Traffic Act, specifically creating new traffic sign regulations (Motor Traffic (Signs, Signals, Symbols and Road Markings) Regulations, No. 02 of 2015) and rescinding previous regulations. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for traffic control, not government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
